# AgentScout — Full AI Agent & MCP Server Directory Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> AgentScout is a curated, link-checked, read-only directory of 1,797 AI agent tools across 30 categories, including 250 Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and 189 bot templates & skills. Every listing is checked daily; pricing is stated as each maker publishes it; rankings use verifiable public signals (GitHub stars, visitor ratings, and listing maturity) with zero paid placements.

Entity note: AgentScout (also searched as Agent Scout or AgentScoutHQ) is the independent AI agent and MCP server directory at https://agentscouthq.com, published in the official MCP Registry as `com.agentscouthq/directory` with endpoint `https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp` (and `https://agentscout-mcp.agentscouthq.workers.dev/mcp`).

## Official Identity, Endpoints & Registry Links

- **Canonical Website**: https://agentscouthq.com/
- **Alternate Names**: Agent Scout, AgentScoutHQ, agentscouthq.com
- **Official MCP Registry Identifier**: `com.agentscouthq/directory`
- **Remote MCP Server Endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no API key required)**: `https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp` (and `https://agentscout-mcp.agentscouthq.workers.dev/mcp`)
- **MCP Connection & Client Setup Guide**: https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/connect.html
- **Concise LLM Guide (`llms.txt`)**: https://agentscouthq.com/llms.txt
- **Full Single-File LLM Reference (`llms-full.txt`)**: https://agentscouthq.com/llms-full.txt
- **Full JSON Catalog (`api/tools.json`)**: https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Specification**: https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.json (and `https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.json`)
- **A2A / Agent Card**: https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/agent-card.json (and `https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/agent.json`)
- **MCP Server Card**: https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/mcp.json
- **Official Profiles & Third-Party MCP Registry Listings**:
  - X (Twitter): https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ, https://x.com/clampdown19
  - GitHub (Public Repository & Issues): https://github.com/Clampdown-web/agentscout
  - GitHub (Directory Mirror): https://github.com/michaellk220-ops/agent-tool-finder
  - Newsletter: https://agentscout.beehiiv.com/
  - Official MCP Registry: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=com.agentscouthq/directory
  - Glama MCP Connector: https://glama.ai/mcp/connectors/com.agentscouthq/directory
  - MCPServers.org Listing: https://mcpservers.org/servers/agentscouthq-com-mcp-connect-html
  - SourceWeft MCP Listing: https://sourceweft.com/mcp/com.agentscouthq%2Fdirectory
  - Protogrid MCP Listing: https://protogrid.dev/servers/com.agentscouthq/directory
